headline: Ramayana tickets could reach 1.09M today and 1.69M tomorrow; Jailer 2 is running quieter, with a smaller peak ahead.
bullets: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana has 446K tickets so far, and today is expected to reach 1.09M (range 906K–1.29M), about -5% vs yesterday.
Its busiest hour still ahead looks like 9–10 PM at an expected 70.6K (range 47.6K–93.2K), after 44K expected at 4–5 PM and 59.3K at 6–7 PM.
Tomorrow (Sat 7 Nov) is expected at 1.69M (range 1.26M–2.31M). This is an opening-day estimate based on earlier films' release-day and day-two patterns, so the range is wide, and signals add +16%.

Jailer 2 has 1.1K tickets so far and could peak at 1.6K at 8–9 PM (range 1.2K–2.1K), about -17% vs yesterday. No review or word-of-mouth signals are tracked for it, so this is a timing-based estimate.
watch: Diwali on 8 Nov could shift weekend bookings for both films.
Ramayana's early ratings are preliminary and vote counts differ across sources, so the +16% signal lift could shrink.
